correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT.md e480171b22c1a702b3a73e910f49a3c79dc98d39 reproduces Bravyi--Kitaev Eq(36) rational recurrence with r=1−2ε. Independently sympy-expanded f−ε = r(1−r²)Q(r²)/(2(1+15r^8)) and reciprocal identity Q(y)/y³=q(y+1/y), q(z)=z³+z²−2z−16, yielding exactly one positive physical root z*=2.459120158... since q(2)<0, q(3)>0 and q′>0 for z≥2. Direction of Q signs proves f<ε below ε*, f>ε above it; AM≥GM establishes f≥0, while f≤1/2 is immediate. Continuous monotone bounded iteration converges to fixed points; endpoints included separately. This is restricted to conditional, ideal postselected protocol; no fidelity claim for non-postselected stochastic rounds.

value.rationale: The H-state 15-to-1 recurrence is a canonical quantum error-distillation map. Knowing a unique exact algebraic threshold and full basin characterizes its deterministic conditional iteration without relying on numerical root selection, and gives precise boundary behavior for calibration. This is motivated exact dynamics of a standard protocol, not an arbitrary algebraic root.

final_claim: For the ideal independent twirled H-input 15-to-1 distillation map, only fixed points in [0,1/2] are 0, epsilon*=0.141480292656167..., 1/2; epsilon* has the displayed unique cubic-root expression and all iterates below/above it converge monotonically to 0/1/2 respectively.
